newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan railways body undecided on bank loans.
newsitem.headline: Japan railways body undecided on bank loans.

text.p: Japan National Railways (JNR) Settlement Corp has not decided whether to borrow funds from the private sector and the government to offset a shortfall in revenues, an official of the Transport Ministry said on Thursday.

"We are now doing our best to secure the amount of revenue we planned for in the budget," said Teruhisa Tanaka, deputy director of the Railway Bureau's JNR Settlement Guidance Division at the Transport Ministry.
He added that JNR Settlement Corp has not made any decision on whether to borrow from banks and the Fiscal Investment and Loan Program (FILP) to balance its budget.
